items.exampleEn: Wash your hands before you eat.

items.exampleZh: 她有一雙棕色的大眼睛。

items.exampleEn: Swimming is good for your body.
Wash your face in the morning.
Smoking is bad for your health.
My grandfather has a bad heart.

items.sentenceEn: My hands and face are cold.

items.audioEn: Wash your hands and face. Dinner is ready.

items.sentenceEn: Running is good for your body and heart.
items.sentenceZh: 跑步對身體和心臟都很好。

items.sentenceEn: Close your eyes and go to sleep.

items.stemEn: I have a ____. I want to go to bed.

items.passageEn: Mr. Lee works at a computer all day. In the evening, his eyes are tired, and he often has a headache. His doctor says, "Your health is important. Take a walk every day, and don't look at your phone at night."
items.passageZh: 李先生整天用電腦工作。到了晚上，他的眼睛很累，而且常常頭痛。他的醫生說：「你的健康很重要。每天去散步，晚上不要看手機。」

questions.questionZh: 李先生晚上常常怎麼了？

rubricZh: 「頭痛」可用 have a headache 或 my head hurts
痛得厲害可用 a bad headache、hurts a lot 等

items.instructionZh: 用 health 造一個句子，說說什麼對健康好或不好。
referenceEn: Fruit is good for your health.
Smoking is bad for your health.
rubricZh: 「對健康好／不好」可用 good／bad for … health（例如 good for your health）
health 前面常加所有格（例如 your health、my health）
